thought.text: Just an ESM interop issue with the import. Fixing:

reasoning_content: The @playwright/test module is CommonJS, so I need to adjust the import statement to use the proper CJS interop.

action.command: sed -i "s|import { chromium } from '/workspace/node_modules/@playwright/test/index.js';|import pw from '/workspace/node_modules/@playwright/test/index.js'; const { chromium } = pw;|" /tmp/render-test.mjs && node /tmp/render-test.mjs; echo "TEST EXIT: $?"

tool_call.arguments: {"command": "sed -i \"s|import { chromium } from '/workspace/node_modules/@playwright/test/index.js';|import pw from '/workspace/node_modules/@playwright/test/index.js'; const { chromium } = pw;|\" /tmp/render-test.mjs && node /tmp/render-test.mjs; echo \"TEST EXIT: $?\"", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Re-run headless browser render test"}
